resources.string: Create an offline portable backup, replace current data from a validated backup, or export an analysis workbook.
Demo mode can export only the demo data workbook.
Saved: %1$s. This provider does not allow read-back verification.

This replaces all current records, Wallet cards and images, and financial and display preferences. It does not merge. Older backups restore an empty Wallet. Private card back details and colors are never backed up; a successful restore permanently clears them. The backup is not encrypted.
Some earlier activity happened before change history was recorded, so it has no before/after values.
This is not a valid Valnook backup.
This backup was made by a newer version of Valnook or is not compatible with this one.
The file failed its integrity or summary checks. Current data was not changed.
Current records changed after preview. Review the file and request a new confirmation code.
The file exceeds a supported safety or spreadsheet limit.
There is not enough storage to validate this file safely.
The file operation could not be completed. Current records were not changed.
Backup completed, but old backup cleanup is incomplete.
The list has not been fetched yet. Tap Refresh to get it.
This backup is no longer in the cloud. The list has been updated.
This backup can be downloaded, but this app version cannot restore it.
No network is available. The due backup will run once you are online.
Network time is temporarily unavailable. The backup will run later.
Microsoft sign-in could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
OneDrive denied access. Check app folder permissions or your organization policy.
The cloud backup folder or file is no longer available. Refresh or reconnect.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 720 hours.
The OneDrive operation could not be completed.
Microsoft and OneDrive are trademarks of Microsoft Corporation.
Microsoft sign-in is not configured for this build. Contact the developer.
OneDrive storage is full. Free some space and try again.
OneDrive is busy. Try again later.
The upload stopped after it started.
OneDrive may have received the file. Valnook will check the result without uploading it again.
The uploaded file could not be verified. Existing backups were kept.
The local backup package could not be prepared.
The automatic exchange rate switch is not restored from backups; this device keeps its current setting.
What goes up: a snapshot of your data (accounts, entries, bills and everything else) and your bill pictures.
Where it goes: the Valnook_backup folder in Valnook\'s app folder in your OneDrive.
Bill pictures go to the bill_images folder in Valnook_backup, shared by all backups; each backup sends only new pictures. Do not change that folder by hand, or pictures may not be restorable.
The last 5 verified backups are kept. A picture no kept backup or bill uses any more is deleted 3 days after it went up.
Disconnecting does not delete the files in OneDrive.
Bill pictures are not backed up yet. Once you have read About OneDrive backup, the next backup sends them too.

A bill_images folder that Valnook did not make is in Valnook_backup in OneDrive, so pictures were not backed up. Delete it or move it elsewhere in OneDrive; the next backup makes a new one. Your data backup is not affected.
%1$d pictures are not uploaded yet; the next backup carries on.
%1$d pictures will be uploaded. Keep the screen on and Valnook in front until it finishes. Switching away or locking the screen stops it; the next time carries on from there.
%1$d pictures will be fetched. Keep the screen on and Valnook in front until it finishes. Switching away or locking the screen stops it; the rest can be fetched later.
%1$d pictures are only in OneDrive. After disconnecting they cannot be fetched from the app (the files in OneDrive are not deleted).
This backup does not include bill pictures (%1$d on this device). After changing phones or uninstalling, pictures can only come back from OneDrive.
The backup holds no bill picture files: pictures already on this device show as before, those in OneDrive can be fetched, and the rest show as missing.
